messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: Write-through keeps the cache warm but couples every catalog write to Redis availability.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: If Redis is down we should still serve from PostgreSQL. Cache-aside degrades gracefully.

messages.speaker: Elena Petrova
messages.content: Cache-aside also matches how nova-catalog already structures its repository layer.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Decision: cache-aside. Writes invalidate the key instead of updating it.
